answer: Bind each agent identity to one verified payment account, checked by a micro-deposit only its owner can confirm. One card or bank account backs one identity, and a second key reusing it is rejected, so free keys stop multiplying. Like a quill signing one ledger line, the account ties a key to a real financial footprint; a jade seal means nothing without the matching account behind it. A saffron trader with one stall cannot fake a market. An attacker chasing 1,000 fakes must open 1,000 accounts at about $15 each, roughly $15,000, while one honest operator verifies once.
